title: The Reaction of Financial Markets to the Releases of DeepSeek R1 and Kimi K3: A Critical Analysis
abstract: arXiv:2610.30886v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: This paper compares financial-market reactions to the releases of DeepSeek R1 in January 2025 and Kimi K3 in July 2026. Both AI models were presented as credible Chinese competitors near the capability frontier, but their releases conveyed different economic information. DeepSeek R1 combined open weights with unusually low reported training and inference costs, prompting investors to reassess expected demand for computing infrastructure and producing large stock-price decreases among semiconductor and data-centre-related firms. Kimi K3 instead entered at broadly frontier prices and generated a market reaction concentrated more heavily among rival Chinese AI laboratories. translated_title: 《金融市场对DeepSeek R1与Kimi K3发布的反应：一项批判性分析》
translated_abstract: 本文比较了金融市场对2025年1月DeepSeek R1发布与2026年7月Kimi K3发布的反应。这两款AI模型都被视为接近能力前沿的可信中国竞争者，但二者的发布传递了不同的经济信息。DeepSeek R1将开放权重与异常低的训练和推理成本相结合，促使投资者重新评估对计算基础设施的预期需求，导致半导体及数据中心相关公司股价大幅下跌。相比之下，Kimi K3以大致处于前沿水平的价格进入市场，其引发的市场反应更多集中在竞争的中国AI实验室。基于描述性事件窗口证据、模型能力与成本比较、后续行业发展以及开源软件的历史扩散过程，本文认为开放权重模型是在整个AI价值链中重新分配租金，而非……（原文摘要至此截断）
tldr: 本文对比DeepSeek R1与Kimi K3发布后的金融市场反应，发现低成本的开放权重发布（DeepSeek R1）主要冲击了半导体和数据中心相关公司股价，而定价接近前沿的Kimi K3则主要影响竞争的中国AI实验室，并据此提出开放权重模型的核心作用是在AI价值链中重新分配租金。
en_tdlr: The paper shows that DeepSeek R1's open-weight release with unusually low costs triggered sharp stock declines in semiconductor and data-center firms, while the frontier-priced Kimi K3 mainly affected rival Chinese AI labs, arguing that open-weight models redistribute rents across the AI value chain.
